citation: Vanaga, Anita (atb. red.). Māksla un arhitektūra biogrāfijās, IV. Rīga: A/S Preses nams, 2003.
title: Māksla un arhitektūra biogrāfijās
isbn_note: Corroborated by three independent sources: a Google Books record (title 'V–Z: Papildinājumi A–U', 303pp), an auction listing (Vitber, lot 17170, 'Preses Nams', 2003, 303pp — page counts match exactly), and OpenLibrary's merged set record (OL574971M), which lists this ISBN alongside the other 4 volumes' numbers, all in the same 9984-00-XXX-X (A/S Preses nams) prefix family as this and Vol III's inferred number. Google Books' own year/publisher fields on its record are wrong (says 1995/Latvijas enciklopēdija; 2003/A/S Preses Nams is correct), so the ISBN is trusted on cross-source corroboration, not on Google's surrounding metadata.
oclc_note: Set-level identifier shared by all 4 volumes — see SRC-MAB-I for detail. One MARC record (OpenLibrary OL574971M) covers the whole work.
lccn_note: Set-level (all 4 volumes) — see SRC-MAB-I for detail. The LC record's own notes field states "Vols. 3-4 published by Preses nams. Vol. 3-4 edited by Anita Vanaga" — direct third-party confirmation this project's volume/editor/publisher table is correct for Vol IV specifically.
